name: Kasumi Mortgage
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for an independent mortgage broker: mist-paper ground, stone panels and ink text with one deep slate band and a single sabi slate-blue accent, Source Serif 4 over Inter. The home page opens on a wide documentary photograph of a couple and an adviser at their kitchen table, with the headline and a short paragraph below it; then a letter from the founder beside the office, the route from the first call to the keys as six photographed steps, what we arrange and what it costs, this week's rates in one quiet table with a worked example, the four people, a dark band for first-time buyers with a client's words, the journal and a call to book. With Mortgages & fees, How it works, Advisers, First-time buyers, Rates & costs, About, Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The office details are one synced pattern, edited once. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
